title: net2 on net1 v4: online TD3+BC from the fixed rule, BC weight by exploration
description: Online net2 on the frozen net1 v4 (exp-net1v4-grid-10's chosen run), starting from the fixed rule at u = 0.125 (its validation choice, exp-rule-net1v4-val-11): TD3+BC with 40-step returns, 40 iterations of 32 rollouts of 30 s over examples/net1_broad.py's net2-train set (600 links of their own, 64 broad conditions). The grid: BC weight alpha 1 or 2.5, by exploration 0.5 or 1.0 (log2 of the window) held 20 steps. Each run is evaluated noise-free every 10 iterations, and before it starts, on the validation links' new-conditions family; that is a diagnostic, and the choice between runs is made on all five validation families afterwards.
run: S="$OUT/spec-a$ALPHA-s$SIGMA.json"; jq --argjson a "$ALPHA" --argjson s "$SIGMA" '.net2.alpha = $a | .noise_sigma = $s' "$OUT/setup/online-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train online "$S" "$OUT/net2-a$ALPHA-s$SIGMA" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
